newsitem.title: USA: Valero closes Basis Pete acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Valero closes Basis Pete acquisition.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said Thursday it has completed the acquisition of Basis Petroleum Inc from Salomon Inc.

The price was very close to the expected cost of $285 million for Basis' stock and $200 million for working capital, spokesman Keith Booke said, noting the final working capital numbers will not be available for a couple months.
The primary assets of Basis include three refineries with total throughput capacity in excess of 300,000 barrels per day and an extensive wholesale marketing business, Valero said.
The three refineries are comprised of a 160,000 barrel per day (bpd) facility in Texas City, Texas; an 85,000 bpd facility in Houston; and a 65,000 bpd facility in Krotz Springs, La.
Including its Corpus Christi refinery, Valero said it now owns and operates four refineries with total capacity of over 500,000 barrels daily.
